description: Frontend build tool and dev server.
summary: AI tools are welcome if you fully understand and can explain what you submit. Comments, issues and PR descriptions must be in your own words.

evidence.quote: Never let an LLM think for you - only submit contributions you fully understand and can explain.
Never let an LLM speak for you - all comments, issues, and PR descriptions should be written in your own words, reflecting your own understanding.
If we find that these principles were not followed, we may close the issue or pull request directly.
